{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Moonlight Scimitar Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Moonlight Scimitar Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 25 |durability= 32 |comp= {{List| * [[Gerudo Scimitar]] * [[Scimitar of the Seven]] }} |sample= |theme= }} '''Moonlight Scimitars''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Moonlight Scimitar|Moonlight Scimitars|Series, BotW, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 25 |durability = 32 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Moonlight Scimitar}} Moonlight Scimitars are sharp [[Weapon]]s with [[Gerudo]]-style engravings that were previously used for ceremonial purposes. These Scimitar belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype, which consists of Weapons created by the Gerudo.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} They can be found throughout the [[Gerudo Desert]] and [[Gerudo Highlands]], particularly within and around [[Gerudo Town]]. The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Moonlight Scimitar when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Rider) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Urbosa]] amiibo As metallic Weapons, Moonlight Scimitars will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]].
